description: Angular component for image input with upload, preview, and validation features, used in the Thingsboard project.

classes.name: ImageInputComponent
classes.description: Angular component for handling image input, including upload, preview, and validation.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Initializes file upload event subscription and handles file addition.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Unsubscribes from upload events to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers callback for touch event (not implemented).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Sets the disabled state of the component.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the image URL and updates the preview accordingly.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Propagates the current value (file or URL) to the parent form.

methods.name: filterFile
methods.description: Filters files based on allowed extensions.

methods.name: clearImage
methods.description: Clears the current image and resets the component state.
